1 · Intro

When to use it.

Normally the recruiter adds a sign-on bonus to the offer, so it processes in one transaction. Use this course when the bonus was left off the offer. The same steps work for a retention bonus.

Use this whenA sign-on (or retention) bonus was left off the offer transaction.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Adding the bonus to the offer is the preferred path. It processes in one transaction and reduces Oracle failures.
  • Amount = gross. Net = take-home. Mixing them up changes what the employee receives.
  • In the award compensation guide, the sign-on bonus element is SGN and a general bonus is BON.

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1What is the preferred way to pay a sign-on bonus?

Q2Which field holds a $1,500 sign-on bonus?

HCM Academy job aid · Compensation Management

Add a sign-on bonus

Use when: A sign-on (or retention) bonus was left off the offer transaction. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Search the employee's name > Individual Compensation (or use the Quick Action).
  2. Click Add > One-time or recurring payment.
  3. Plan: Bonus.
  4. Start date: the first day of the target payroll month (for example, Nov 1).
  5. Enter the amount in the Amount field, not Net (for example, $1,500). The employee pays the taxes.
  6. Leave Process separately set to Yes. Click Save.
  7. Click Continue, add comments or attachments, then Submit.

Watch-outs

  • Adding the bonus to the offer is the preferred path. It processes in one transaction and reduces Oracle failures.
  • Amount = gross. Net = take-home. Mixing them up changes what the employee receives.
  • In the award compensation guide, the sign-on bonus element is SGN and a general bonus is BON.
